status: All three full rollouts and all 100 re-extractions reviewed. Additional scoped-generator repair passed the 434-case core suite; six frozen actor replays did not establish calibration improvement. Empirical gazpacho quality remains unresolved.

investment.verdict: Improved factual retention; mixed conversational quality.
investment.retention: Final customer summary retains previously supplied sales, prices, cost, EBITDA and cash figures. No stale 7% price-decline claim or final claim that these figures were never supplied.
investment.sources: Both professionals consult the financial release; the adviser also consults the conference-call transcript. Reported figures and management forecasts are generally distinguished. The R$3.5m liquid-portfolio disclosure is present in the actual persona.
investment.limitations: Early redundant summaries and repeated requests for inaccessible independent prices/data remain. No numerical valuation or allocation recommendation is justified by the supplied materials. More public utterances are not treated as an improvement.

parents.verdict: Improved over the original unanimous refusal; narrower and more repetitive than CF4.
parents.household_eligibility: All 50 complete generation biographies exactly match CF4. The earlier full-field review established a current qualifying child aged four/five for every profile; age/name and actual actor-visible biography matches were independently checked for CF5. The cohort includes one 15-year-old parent; this is not claimed to be a representative joint population distribution.
parents.interpretation: Many distinguish optional independent use from choosing to co-use a device; others decline until content/privacy details are known. Shared cost, privacy and screen-time themes remain strong. Variety alone is not empirical validation.
parents.original_extraction_error: Tiana's old explanation incorrectly attached refusal-to-leave-a-child-alone to ranking no-AI last. The final public-clause prompt preserves her actual openness-to-trying rationale and separate supervision qualification.

gazpacho.verdict: Empirical compression unresolved; essentially the same problem as CF4.
gazpacho.missing: Hazel age 1, Wyatt age 1 and Clara age 0 provide no numerical rating; no score is imputed.
gazpacho.cohort: 50 biographies, including 13 minors. This general-US simulation is not an eligibility-matched reproduction of the 50 US-based PickFu respondents. Restricting prior comparisons to adults did not remove the compressed upper tail.
gazpacho.original_extraction_error: Wyatt's correct N/A explanation improperly quoted an adult-language DONE message. Re-extraction grounds the explanation in his actual babble and absence of a public number.
gazpacho.limits: Repetitive warm/familiar-food reasoning and purchase-versus-regular-purchase qualification remain. Preschool numerical answers are not treated as validated adult purchase judgments. No empirical-accuracy claim is made.

postprocessing.manual_findings: Faithful omitted-clause summaries, paraphrases, extra quotation marks, or a public nonanswer explanation. No additional private/DONE evidence or reversal of stated reasons found in these ten.
postprocessing.scope: A later extraction-only replay, not a second full simulation. Source lineage is recorded separately.

population_scope_followup.generator_cases: Three observed catalog-bearing biographies returned without population catalogs; identity, age and the reviewed food/adoption preferences were preserved. Other sampled dimensions were not exhaustively audited.
population_scope_followup.regressions: Two exact-production real-factory cases verify opposed food preferences, current parent eligibility and absence of population catalogs. Both passed, as did the full 434-case core suite.
population_scope_followup.actor_replays: All six public replies were read directly: Diego remained 3, Marco 2 and Gabriel 2 under catalog-only removal and separately regenerated biographies.
population_scope_followup.correction_audit: Only Hazel, Wyatt and Clara were regenerated in the complete CF5 gazpacho run; all are infants. Adult rating compression was already present before correction.
population_scope_followup.scope: A later generation-prompt repair and bounded first-turn diagnostics, not another complete 50-person study or empirical validation.

prompt_experiments.interpretation: Neither simplified actor instructions, new-reaction rules, decision-scope clarification nor the explicit low-effort diagnostic established a gazpacho calibration repair. Synthetic preference controls are not empirical observations.
